name: Tilt-Shift Diorama
summary: A toy model town under a tilt-shift lens; the Pulse van patrols and focus pulls to the one billboard that dropped.
look: Saturated toy buildings, tiny figures and trees under warm sun, a thin razor-sharp focus band with creamy blur above and below, warm bokeh at the edges.

components.name: Diorama board
components.role: the town as low-poly boxes under a 35° perspective camera (not isometric)

components.name: Focus band
components.role: a gradient mask over a blurred duplicate — only a thin band stays sharp

components.name: Rooftop screens
components.role: billboards that show each metric's sparkline

components.name: Pulse van
components.role: a teal toy vehicle carrying the Acme mark — the agent on patrol

components.name: Tiny operator
components.role: a figure at a console with a big coral button — the human decision

components.name: Bokeh dots
components.role: defocused warm lights in the out-of-focus zones

motion.name: Focus pull
motion.how: the sharp band slides to the subject, power2.inOut 0.8 s, arriving on the downbeat — it replaces cuts

motion.name: Toy speed
motion.how: vehicles and people move slightly fast on steps(12), which sells the miniature scale

motion.name: Slow dolly
motion.how: translateZ creep with layer parallax across the whole 8-bar phrase, linear, never on the beat

story: Hook: the focus band drifts over a town of rooftop dashboard screens until it finds the coral dip. Reveal: the teal Pulse van with the Acme mark stops in focus on the drop and “Acme Pulse” rises. Proof: focus racks to the plaza billboard — “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231” — then down to a tiny operator hitting “Roll back”. CTA: the band settles on a lockup billboard, “Caught before customers noticed.” and “Start free”.
adapt: Build your product's world as a model town (services as buildings, users as figures, your agent as the vehicle) and put your one key alert on the billboard where focus lands.

fit.risk: Blur limits copy to the focus band; keep overlay type on calm defocused zones.
